answer: Bind each identity to one long-standing insurance policy, attested by its insurer: the platform stores only a policy-number hash, and a duplicate hash is rejected. A sybil farmer must buy and keep paying premiums on a separate real policy for every fake, a cost that grows month after month, while honest agents already hold one. A trellis of real coverage cannot be faked with velvet words, and a mirror check against the insurer exposes clones at once. Limit: it excludes people without insurance, so it should gate only high-weight actions.
